svg.title: MPx Spin v1.1 — how it goes together · exploded view
svg.desc: Illustrative exploded view of MPx Spin v1.1 after TRIZ and FMEA: vanes welded into the basket (no separate insert), a two-layer cellulose sleeve with staggered seams sitting on a silicone floor gasket, a lid lock beside the interlock switch, and two conductivity pins in the spout that tell the controller when a batch has drained. Numbers match the BOM items. A concept, not a manufacturing design.
